title: SAM Simplifier Plan
description:
A complete description of a desired simplified version. Every version is generated from the ORIGINAL song, never from a previous version, so plans compose without cumulative degradation. See docs/technical-spec-sam-simplifier.md §3.

This schema is the primary defence against vocabulary drift: `additionalProperties: false` everywhere means an unknown setting key is a hard error rather than a silently ignored one, and every setting is a closed enum. A language model selects from these values; it never emits notation.

planVersion.description: Currently 1. Bump only for a breaking change to plan semantics.

sourceSongId.description: Provenance only. Nothing is fetched with it — the simplifier never touches the database.

label.description: Free text. Appended to the output song title in parentheses when present.

default.description: Settings applied to every measure not covered by a range.

ranges.description: Overrides. A measure may appear in at most one range; overlaps are rejected rather than resolved by order.

Settings.description: The fixed settings vocabulary (spec §4). Adding a value later is additive and safe; anything not listed here is rejected.

lhGrid.description: Cell size for LH quantization. `none` is a no-op. Grid quantization, not event merging — the duration vocabulary is not closed under addition, so merging can produce unwritable durations.

lhFill.description: Which pitches fill a cell. `onset` = pitches sounding at the cell start. `union` = all distinct pitches sounding anywhere in the cell; it can emit chords that never occurred in the original and made LH jump WORSE in prototyping.

lhCap.description: Max notes per LH event after fill.

lhKeep.description: Which notes survive the cap. `root-third` keeps the lowest lhCap notes; `root-fifth` keeps lowest and highest.

rhStack.description: RH thinning. Removes notes from within an event; never removes an event, which is what keeps rh_index stable and lyrics intact.

measures.description: Comma-separated PLAYED measure numbers (SAM's `number`) and inclusive ranges, e.g. "37,57-61,68". Not printed numbers (`sourceMeasure`).

settings.description: `null` means leave these measures untouched. Otherwise a partial settings object overriding `default` for these measures only. Required — an omitted key would make "untouched" happen by accident.
